legalPage_contactLead: Questions, or a request about your data:
privacyPage_summary: Hoi Toi is a free mahjong game run as a personal project. You can play without an account. If you sign in, we keep only what an account needs: your games and your learn progress. There are no ads, no tracking or analytics, and we don't sell your data.
privacyPage_guestDevice: Your display name, settings and learn progress stay in this browser's storage.
privacyPage_guestGames: When a game finishes, the server saves its record: the moves, the scores and the name typed at each seat. A guest seat isn't linked to anything else.
privacyPage_guestNetwork: Like any website, the server and our hosting providers see your IP address when you connect. The app uses it to limit abuse and doesn't save it with your games or account; server logs may contain it.
privacyPage_accountIntro: An account is optional. Signing in with Google stores:
privacyPage_accountGoogle: From Google, an account identifier and your email address. We ask Google for nothing else: not your name, photo or contacts.
privacyPage_accountName: Your display name. It starts as "Player" and four digits until you choose one, and other players see it at the table.
privacyPage_accountSessions: Your sign-in sessions: a scrambled copy of each session key, with when it started and was last used. A session ends after 30 days unused, or after 90 days at most.
privacyPage_accountGames: Your games: for each game you finish while signed in, a link from your seat to your account, with your placing and score.
privacyPage_accountLearn: Your learn progress: lessons solved and tried, endless-mode scores, your learn settings, and when you last added this browser's progress to your account.
privacyPage_accountConsent: Your training choice (below), when you made it and which wording you agreed to.
privacyPage_accountUse: We use these to sign you in, show your name and games, and keep your learn progress the same on every device. Your email is only a way to reach you about your account: no newsletters, no marketing.
privacyPage_trainingOptIn: This is opt-in and off unless you tick it, when you first sign in or later in account settings. If you opt in, games you play while signed in may be used, without your name, to train and test the computer opponents.
privacyPage_trainingWithdraw: You can turn it off at any time, and your games aren't used for new training after that. A model already trained can't unlearn a game.
privacyPage_trainingNow: No player's games are used for training today. Games played as a guest are never used.
privacyPage_cookiesIntro: There are no advertising or tracking cookies. The cookies we set:
privacyPage_cookieSession: Keeps you signed in. Page scripts can't read it, and it lasts as long as your session.
privacyPage_cookieOauth: Holds the sign-in handshake with Google, for up to 10 minutes.
privacyPage_cookiesStorage: Settings, your guest name and guest learn progress are kept in this browser's local storage. They stay on your device unless you add your progress to an account.
privacyPage_providerAws: Amazon Web Services, which hosts the server and database in the United States.
privacyPage_providerCloudflare: Cloudflare, which carries traffic between your browser and the server.
privacyPage_providersNote: Each works under its own privacy policy. We don't sell or hand your data to anyone else.
privacyPage_keepAccount: Account data is kept until you delete your account. Expired sessions are removed automatically.
privacyPage_keepDelete: Deleting your account in account settings takes effect at once. It removes your account, its Google link, its sessions and its learn progress. Past games stay, with the name typed at the table, but no longer link to you.
privacyPage_keepGames: Game records, guest or signed in, are kept with no set end date.
privacyPage_choicesExport: Ask for a copy of everything your account holds, through the contact below, and you'll get it as a JSON file.
privacyPage_choicesEdit: Change your display name or your training choice at any time.
privacyPage_choicesOther: For anything else, such as a correction, use the contact below.
privacyPage_childrenBody: Hoi Toi isn't aimed at children under 13, and we don't knowingly create accounts for them.
privacyPage_changesBody: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it. A change to how account data is used is announced in the app first, and training never uses your games without your opt-in.
termsPage_summary: Hoi Toi is a free mahjong game, offered as is. Play fair, be decent to other players, and don't use it for gambling. Using the site means you accept these terms.
termsPage_serviceBody: Hoi Toi is a personal project and free to use. It may change, go offline or end at any time, and there's no promise that games, accounts or progress will always be kept.
termsPage_accountsBody: An account is optional. You sign in with your own Google account and are responsible for what's done with it here. You can delete your account at any time.
termsPage_conductIntro: When you use Hoi Toi, don't:
termsPage_conductName: pick a display name that's offensive or pretends to be someone else;
termsPage_conductCheat: cheat, team up with other players at a table, or use software to play against people for you;
termsPage_conductService: overload, disrupt or probe the service, or try to reach other people's accounts or data.
termsPage_conductAction: A player who breaks these rules may be removed from a table, and their account disabled.
termsPage_gamblingBody: Scores and points in Hoi Toi have no money value. Don't use the site to settle bets or wagers.
termsPage_namesBody: Your display name is shown to other players and saved in game records. You let us keep and show it there, including after you delete your account.
termsPage_sourceBody: Hoi Toi's source code is public on GitHub under its own licence. These terms cover the site we run, not your use of the code.
termsPage_warrantyBody: The site is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. As far as the law allows, we aren't liable for any loss from using it or from it being unavailable. Nothing here limits rights you have under the law where you live.
termsPage_changesBody: These terms may be updated; the date above changes when they are. Using the site after a change means you accept the new terms.
